title: Crime And Special Branch - Re - Arrest Of One Doo Tuh-Sung For Possession Of Firearms

REPORT
CONFIDENTIAL
Subject (in full) Report made by C.D.C.155 Fan Tsoong-ngoh (潘志岳 ) re arrest of
one Doo Tuh-sung (杜得勝 ) for possession of firearms.
Made by C.D.C.155 Fan Tsoong-ngoh Forwarded by (签名)
Translated by D.I.Kuh Pao-hwa

(左侧手写批注：See Louza D.I.R. 24/3/31)

Between 8 a.m. and 12.30 p.m. on October 6, 1931,
I was on special duty at the Head Post Office, keeping observation
on a certain private letter box. At 1.45 p.m. while I was having
tiffin at my home, No.18a Burkill Road, an informer called and
reported to me that there was a man in possession of a pistol,
living in room No.88 of the Sing Dah Tung (新大同 ) Lodging House,
No.309 Hankow Road, and that he kept the weapon together with
a quantity of ammunition in a drawer in the dressing table in
the room.

Accompanied by the informer I proceeded to the lodging
house in question. While passing the door of room No.88,
which was open, I casually looked in and saw four men sitting
in different parts of the room. I did not enter the room.
The informer entered as he knew the occupants by sight, having
come into contact with them through his capacity of barber
in the lodging house. I then telephoned Louza Station, and
after informing them what I had been told requested them to
send someone search the room. Some five minutes later
a party of detectives, foreign and Chinese, attached to Louza
Station arrived at the lodging house, and I pointed out to them
the location of the room. I also entered the room but took
no part in the search, which resulted in the finding of a pistol
and a quantity of ammunition in the place given by the informer,
and one man named Doo Tuh Sung, who claimed to be the owner
of the weapon being apprehended.

According to this individual he purchased the pistol
in France where he has been working as a labourer for the
past 16 years. He states that he recently returned to Shanghai,
and asserts that he is ignorant of the regulations of the

日期：1931年10月8日。

报告
机密
事由（全称）：关于警探主任155号潘志岳（Fan Tsoong-ngoh）就杜得勝（Doo Tuh-sung）因持有枪械被捕一事所作的报告。
报告人：警探主任155号 潘志岳 转呈人：（签名）
翻译：督察 顾宝华（Kuh Pao-hwa）

（左侧手写批注：见老闸捕房督察员报告，1931年3月24日）

1931年10月6日上午8时至下午12时30分之间，
我在邮政总局执行特别任务，监视某个私人信箱。下午1时45分，当我在位于伯基尔路18a号的家中用午餐时，一名线人前来向我报告，称有一名男子持有手枪，居住在汉口路309号新大同（Sing Dah Tung）客栈的88号房间，并将该武器及大量弹药存放在房内梳妆台的一个抽屉里。

在线人的陪同下，我前往上述客栈。经过敞开的88号房间门口时，我随意向内看了一眼，看见四名男子坐在房间的不同位置。我没有进入房间。线人进入了房间，因为他通过在该客栈担任理发师的工作与住客有过接触，面熟这些住客。随后我打电话给老闸捕房，在告知他们我所听到的情况后，请求他们派人搜查该房间。大约五分钟后，隶属于老闸捕房的一队中外探员抵达客栈，我向他们指出了房间的位置。我也进入了房间，但未参与搜查。搜查结果是在线人提供的地点发现了一把手枪和大量弹药，并逮捕了一名自称是该武器所有者的男子，名为杜得勝（Doo Tuh Sung）。

据此人称，他在过去16年间一直在法国做劳工，手枪是在法国购买的。他声称最近才回到上海，并坚称自己对工部局
